skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-meta-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Set up Meta bidding for observed customer lifetime value with Cloudflare Tracking and Product Metrics. Check event delivery and choose a revenue or profit conversion in Meta.
skill.summary: Connect Cloudflare purchase tracking to Meta and verify lifetime value events before changing an ad set.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting, documentation links, or ordinary setup steps. Confirmed risks include unpinned installer execution, writes without explicit approval, order data exposure, and blanket permission approval. The review also found unsafe token handling, unvalidated browser handoffs, and conflicting guidance about the LTV conversion.

remediation.issue: The agent may request a Meta access token and forward it to a command.
remediation.suggestion: Require direct entry in the Product Metrics app or an approved secret input. Remove instructions to collect tokens in chat or pass them as command arguments.

remediation.issue: The installer can execute an unpinned package and fetch a mutable skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and skill revision, document integrity checks, and require approval before running the installer.

remediation.issue: Agent writes have retry rules but no general approval requirement.
remediation.suggestion: Preview the company, property, target, and effect of each write. Obtain explicit approval before creating or changing a tracking destination.

remediation.issue: Order diagnostics request raw JSON without limiting the returned fields.
remediation.suggestion: Use a single authorized test order and request only the fields needed for verification. Redact customer and commercial data before returning tool results.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare troubleshooting tells users to approve every requested permission.
remediation.suggestion: List required permissions and explain why each is needed. Verify the app identity and selected zone, and stop if the request includes unexpected access.

remediation.issue: The agent relays browser action URLs without checking the destination.
remediation.suggestion: Verify HTTPS, the exact hostname, and the expected action before presenting a link. Direct users to the official dashboard when verification fails.

remediation.issue: The main workflow names per-order profit as the conversion for an LTV goal.
remediation.suggestion: Use the dedicated profit LTV event and matching purpose rule. Verify the exact event and purpose before recommending any ad set change.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Browser Handoff
semantic_findings.description: The workflow directs the operator to open a URL from setup output without checking its destination. A tampered response could redirect a sign-in to an unexpected site.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill directly relays the returned URL, and the Cloudflare setup requires sign-in and consent. There is no evidence that a malicious URL was returned.

semantic_findings.title: Per-Order Profit Substituted for Lifetime Profit
semantic_findings.description: The main LTV workflow recommends PMOrderProfit, while the Meta guide identifies it as per-order profit and lists LTV separately. Following it can optimize live spend for the wrong signal.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The conflicting event guidance is explicit. The operator still selects the event, so the effect depends on following the incorrect recommendation.

content.user_title: Set Up Meta LTV Bidding with Cloudflare
content.value_statement: First-order revenue can understate the value of repeat buyers. Connect Cloudflare purchase tracking to Meta and verify the revenue or profit signal before using it for bidding.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through the CLI or MCP server to identify completed steps.
Guide a workspace admin through Cloudflare gateway authorization and storefront property linking.
Guide an operator through connecting a Meta pixel or dataset and checking test event delivery.
Check whether customer recognition, consent, and costs support revenue or profit LTV events.
Explain how to create and select the dedicated LTV custom conversion in Meta.
limitations: The setup requires Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare DNS record, and access to the workspace and Meta pixel.
Cloudflare Tracking uses observed purchases and does not import past orders by default.
Profit LTV requires known order costs. For Cloudflare orders, profit depends on a product cost estimate and configured additional costs.
The operator authorizes Cloudflare access and makes Meta campaign changes.

use_cases.title: Assess LTV readiness
use_cases.description: Find out whether a Cloudflare storefront can send revenue LTV events to Meta without a store plugin.

use_cases.title: Verify tracking and consent
use_cases.description: Check the gateway, banner selection, and test delivery before passing setup to the ads team.

use_cases.title: Prepare a profit LTV pilot
use_cases.description: Check cost coverage and verify the dedicated profit LTV conversion before selecting it for one ad set.

prompt_templates.title: List the prerequisites
prompt_templates.scenario: You are evaluating the setup before connecting any accounts.
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need to set up Meta revenue LTV bidding for my Cloudflare storefront. Do not connect accounts or ask for credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Check setup status
prompt_templates.scenario: Your Product Metrics property is already connected.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the setup status for my selected property. Tell me whether the gateway, Meta destination, and consent settings are ready. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a missing LTV event
prompt_templates.scenario: A test purchase is visible, but the expected LTV event is missing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my redacted test results to check why profit LTV is missing. Review customer recognition, consent, costs, and Meta delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a one-ad-set pilot
prompt_templates.scenario: Revenue and profit LTV test events have both arrived.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare revenue and profit LTV for one ad set. Verify the dedicated event and purpose, explain the ROAS goal, and leave all changes to me.

output_examples.input: Can I use revenue LTV if my storefront does not report product costs?
output_examples.output: Revenue LTV does not require product costs. Confirm that a test purchase identifies the customer and that the shopper grants the required consent.

output_examples.input: Meta shows revenue LTV from my test order but no profit LTV.
output: Revenue LTV delivery is confirmed for the test order.
Check the product cost fallback and additional costs before retesting profit LTV.

output_examples.input: My test event arrived. What should I verify before changing my ad set?
output: Clear the test event code and confirm delivery.
Check that the custom conversion uses the correct LTV event, purpose, and event value.
Select the conversion yourself in one pilot ad set.

best_practices: Enter the Meta access token directly in the Product Metrics app, not in assistant chat.
Use a test purchase to verify the required consent, event delivery, and value before changing an ad set.
Start with one campaign and choose a ROAS goal for the selected LTV signal.
anti_patterns: Approve Cloudflare permissions without checking the app, requested access, and selected zone.
Use the per-order profit conversion as a substitute for the dedicated profit LTV conversion.
Leave a test event code enabled and expect new events to count in reporting.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin?
faq.answer: No. Cloudflare Tracking reads purchases from the order confirmation page on a proxied Cloudflare storefront.

faq.question: What value does Meta receive?
faq.answer: The event value is what the order adds to lifetime revenue or profit. The observed running total can be sent separately when available.

faq.question: Does this include purchases from before setup?
faq.answer: Not by default. Cloudflare Tracking starts with the purchases it receives after setup.

faq.question: What consent do LTV events require?
faq.answer: The LTV guide requires both analytics and ad user data consent before an event is sent to Meta.

faq.question: Why is the profit LTV event missing?
faq.answer: Check that the order has complete costs and that Meta received a qualifying test event. The event appears in the selector only after delivery.

faq.question: Will the assistant change my campaign?
faq.answer: No. You create the custom conversion in Meta and choose it as the ad set's optimization event.
